"Game Title: Grand City: Crime Empire

Create a realistic, 3D, open-world action-adventure game inspired by GTA 5.

Environment:

- A huge modern city with skyscrapers, highways, beaches, villages, airports, and mountains.
- Realistic day-and-night cycle.
- Dynamic weather, including rain, storms, and sunshine.
- Pedestrians, traffic, shops, and interactive buildings.

- Open-world free roaming.
- Drive cars, superbikes, helicopters, boats, and planes.
- Play story missions and side missions.
- Explore the city on foot or by vehicle.
- Customize cars, clothes, and houses.
- Include a realistic traffic and vehicle physics system.
- Add police chase missions and a wanted-level system.
- Include an in-game mobile phone and map.

Graphics:

- Ultra-realistic 3D graphics.
- High-quality textures and lighting.
- Realistic vehicle damage and reflections.
- Cinematic camera angles.
- Smooth character animations.

Characters:

- A main playable character.
- Different NPCs with unique behaviors.
- Character customization.

Controls:

- Smooth keyboard and mouse controls.
- Mobile touchscreen controls.
- Driving, running, jumping, and interacting buttons.

Goal:
Build a massive, immersive open-world sandbox game where players can freely explore a living city, drive vehicles, complete missions, and experience an exciting story.

Make the game playable, interactive, optimized, and visually impressive. (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

## Objective
- Build a playable browser-based 3D open-world action-adventure game, **Grand City: Crime Empire**, for phones and tablets.

## Requirements
- Include a modern city, roaming, vehicles, missions, phone/map, weather, wanted level, and keyboard and touchscreen controls.
- Aim for immersive visuals and smooth gameplay; state reasonable assumptions and limitations at completion.

## Decisions
- Use Three.js with procedural geometry and UI, without external game assets.
- Treat the result as a prototype rather than a full-scale open-world simulation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented procedural city, on-foot and vehicle movement, traffic and pedestrians, mission marker, minimap, phone apps, vehicle paint choices, day/night, weather, wanted stars, and touch controls.
- Fixed pedestrian metadata loss and guarded NPC leg animation against missing leg arrays.
- Verified `node --check game.js`; reloaded in-browser with zero console errors.
- Tested starting the game and phone weather/garage interactions; captured and inspected `screenshots/final.jpg` and `screenshots/mobile.jpg`.

- `game.js`: Three.js world, gameplay, controls, NPCs, vehicles, and weather.
- `index.html`: Game shell, HUD, phone, mission UI, and touch controls.
- `style.css`: Responsive interface styling.
- `screenshots/final.jpg`: Browser capture of the game.
- `screenshots/mobile.jpg`: Mobile-sized browser capture.

- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
